# 🌍 c4e

![](reference/figures/logo.png)

## Climate data for economists

c4e links climate rasters to household surveys. It extracts climate data
at survey locations and administrative divisions, computes weather
extreme indicators, standardised drought indices and spatial controls,
and summarises them over the reference period before each interview,
ready to merge with survey data and export to Stata.

Tables carry their context from one step to the next: the variable, its
unit, the time step, the thresholds, percentiles and spell lengths used.
A value given once is not typed again, and every table can print the
steps that produced it.

c4e succeeds
[climatic4economist](https://github.com/jmr-fao/climatic4economist),
which stays available unchanged for existing scripts.

> **Status:** under development. The design and progress are in
> `dev/PLAN_v2.md` and `dev/LOG_v2.md`.

## 📘 Features

- **One call per question**:
  [`weather_extremes()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/weather_extremes.md),
  [`climate_indices()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/climate_indices.md),
  [`static_controls()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/static_controls.md)
  and
  [`time_varying_controls()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/time_varying_controls.md)
  run the whole chain from a survey and a raster, with named presets
  ([`list_presets()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/list_presets.md)),
  a dry run, and step-by-step progress
- **Maps and grid panels**:
  [`grid_indicators()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/grid_indicators.md)
  and
  [`grid_controls()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/grid_controls.md)
  compute the same indicators and controls for every cell of a raster,
  block by block, and write GeoTIFFs that keep their context
- Read climate rasters with their dates, unit and variable (ERA5,
  CHIRPS, WFDE5, GAEZ and your own sources)
- Convert units, including rates per day, month or year
- Extract at survey locations, buffers, polygons or cells, with CRS
  checks
- Daily extremes: thresholds, percentiles, spells, heatwaves, custom
  conditions
- Standardised indices (SPI, SPEI) and climatic parameters, with
  coefficients of variation of temperatures computed on kelvin
- Window summaries before each interview: lags, seasons, fixed periods,
  time since an event, with a minimum coverage
- Stata export with variable labels and a codebook; table checks and
  summaries
- Memory-aware: large jobs split automatically, with progress messages

## 📥 Installation

``` r

remotes::install_github("jmr-fao/c4e")
```

## 🚀 In one call

``` r

survey <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "survey.csv", package = "c4e"))
survey$interview <- as.Date(survey$interview)

hot <- c4e::weather_extremes(
  survey,
  system.file("extdata", "tmax_daily.tif", package = "c4e"),
  id = hhid, interview = interview,
  preset = "heat"                 # days above 30 and 35 C, and their spells
)

c4e::c4e_history(hot)             # the equivalent step-by-step chain
c4e::write_stata(hot, "hot_days.dta", codebook = TRUE)
```

## 🔧 Step by step

``` r

tmax <- c4e::read_climate(
  system.file("extdata", "tmax_daily.tif", package = "c4e"))

coord  <- c4e::prepare_coord(survey, lat_var = lat, lon_var = lon,
                             id = hhid, interview = interview)
points <- c4e::georef_coord(coord)

hot_days <- c4e::extract_by_coord(tmax, points) |>
  c4e::convert_unit("C") |>
  c4e::calc_threshold_day(above = c(30, 35)) |>
  c4e::calc_spell() |>
  c4e::summarise_by_interview(coord, x = _, window = c4e::window_lag("1 year"))
```

## 📦 Dependencies

terra, exactextractr, sf, SPEI, the tidyverse (dplyr, tidyr, purrr,
tibble), cli, vctrs and lifecycle; haven for the Stata export.

# Package index

## One call per question

Wrappers that run the whole chain from a survey and a raster, with
presets and a short argument list.

- [`weather_extremes()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/weather_extremes.md)
  : Extreme weather before each interview, in one call
- [`climate_indices()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/climate_indices.md)
  : Standardised precipitation indices before each interview, in one
  call
- [`static_controls()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/static_controls.md)
  : Location controls that do not change over time, in one call
- [`time_varying_controls()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/time_varying_controls.md)
  : Location controls in the survey year, in one call
- [`list_presets()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/list_presets.md)
  : List the presets of the wrappers
- [`extremes_control()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/extremes_control.md)
  [`indices_control()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/extremes_control.md)
  [`controls_control()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/extremes_control.md)
  : Further options of the wrappers

## Every cell of a raster

Indicators, parameters and controls returned as rasters.

- [`grid_indicators()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/grid_indicators.md)
  : Weather extremes for every cell of a raster, in one call
- [`grid_controls()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/grid_controls.md)
  : Spatial controls for every cell of a raster, in one call
- [`calc_threshold_day(`*`<SpatRaster>`*`)`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/grid_methods.md)
  [`calc_percentile(`*`<SpatRaster>`*`)`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/grid_methods.md)
  [`calc_par(`*`<SpatRaster>`*`)`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/grid_methods.md)
  [`calc_std_index(`*`<SpatRaster>`*`)`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/grid_methods.md)
  : Indicators for every cell of a raster

## Reading rasters and boundaries

- [`read_climate()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/read_climate.md)
  : Read a climate raster with its context
- [`raster_meta()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/raster_meta.md)
  : Context recorded on a raster
- [`list_sources()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/list_sources.md)
  : List the data sources read_climate() recognises
- [`register_source()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/register_source.md)
  : Teach read_climate() a data source
- [`read_boundaries()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/read_boundaries.md)
  : Read administrative boundaries
- [`aggregate_time()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/aggregate_time.md)
  : Aggregate a raster to a coarser time step
- [`select_by_dates()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/select_by_dates.md)
  : Select time observations based on date range
- [`select_by_season()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/select_by_season.md)
  : Select Columns of a Data Frame Corresponding to a Seasonal Period
- [`convert_unit()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/convert_unit.md)
  : Convert data to another unit
- [`list_units()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/list_units.md)
  : List the unit conversions
- [`register_unit()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/register_unit.md)
  : Add a unit conversion

## The survey side

- [`prepare_coord()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/prepare_coord.md)
  : Prepare ID for unique occurrences
- [`georef_coord()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/georef_coord.md)
  : Georeference based on coordinates and coordinate reference system
- [`window_lag()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/window_lag.md)
  [`window_season()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/window_lag.md)
  [`window_fixed()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/window_lag.md)
  [`window_since()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/window_lag.md)
  : Reference windows for survey summaries
- [`select_by_interview()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/select_by_interview.md)
  : Select time observations based on interview date and time interval

## Extraction

- [`extract_by_coord()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/extract_by_coord.md)
  : Extract values from a SpatRaster
- [`extract_by_poly()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/extract_by_poly.md)
  : Extract and Aggregate Raster Values by Polygons
- [`extract_cell_by_poly()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/extract_cell_by_poly.md)
  : Extract Raster Values by Polygon
- [`extract_weighted_by_poly()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/extract_weighted_by_poly.md)
  : Weighted Mean or Mode of Raster Values by Polygon
- [`aggregate_to_adm()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/aggregate_to_adm.md)
  : Aggregate cell indicators to administrative divisions

## Daily indicators

- [`calc_threshold_day()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_threshold_day.md)
  : Flag days beyond thresholds
- [`calc_condition()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_condition.md)
  : Flag days that meet a condition
- [`calc_percentile()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_percentile.md)
  : Percentiles of daily values by unit and month
- [`calc_percentile_day()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_percentile_day.md)
  : Flag days beyond their unit's monthly percentiles
- [`calc_spell()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_spell.md)
  : Spells of consecutive flagged days
- [`calc_spell_percentile()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_spell_percentile.md)
  : Percentiles of spell lengths by unit and month
- [`calc_spell_excess()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_spell_excess.md)
  : Spells longer than usual
- [`calc_heatwave()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_heatwave.md)
  : Heatwaves as defined by the WMO

## Standardised indices and parameters

- [`calc_std_index()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_std_index.md)
  : Standardised precipitation indices: SPI and SPEI
- [`calc_std_threshold()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_std_threshold.md)
  : Flag months beyond thresholds of a standardised index
- [`calc_par()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_par.md) :
  Climatic parameters per unit

## Summaries over windows and periods

- [`summarise_by_interview()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/summarise_by_interview.md)
  : Summarise indicators over each household's reference period
- [`summarise_by_period()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/summarise_by_period.md)
  : Summarise indicators by calendar period
- [`merge_with_survey()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/merge_with_survey.md)
  : Merge survey observations with other data.
- [`merge_by_common()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/merge_by_common.md)
  : Merge Data Frames or Lists by Common Variable(s)

## Tables with context

- [`c4e_meta()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/c4e_tbl.md)
  [`is_c4e_tbl()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/c4e_tbl.md)
  [`update_meta()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/c4e_tbl.md)
  : Tables that carry their context
- [`bind_indicators()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/bind_indicators.md)
  : Join indicator tables side by side
- [`c4e_history()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/c4e_history.md)
  : Show the steps that produced a table
- [`c4e_labels()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/c4e_labels.md)
  : Labels describing the columns of a table
- [`validate_c4e()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/validate_c4e.md)
  : Check a table for common data problems
- [`summary(`*`<c4e_tbl>`*`)`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/summary.c4e_tbl.md)
  : Summarise a c4e table

## Export

- [`write_stata()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/write_stata.md)
  : Write a table to Stata with labelled variables
- [`to_stata_format()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/to_stata_format.md)
  : Convert Variable Names to Stata-Compatible Format

## Spatial helpers

- [`crop_with_buffer()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/crop_with_buffer.md)
  : Crop a Raster with a Buffer around a Vector Layer
- [`fill_missing_rast()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/fill_missing_rast.md)
  : Fill Missing Raster Values Using Neighboring Cells
- [`split_raster()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/split_raster.md)
  : Split a Raster into Smaller Tiles
- [`align_count_rast()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/align_count_rast.md)
  : Align a Count Raster onto the Grid of Another Raster
- [`calc_distance()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_distance.md)
  : Compute Distances Between Spatial Objects (using purrr::partial)
- [`calc_nearest_distance()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_nearest_distance.md)
  : Calculate nearest distance between two SpatVector objects
- [`calc_weighted_distance()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_weighted_distance.md)
  : Calculate weighted (least-cost) distance to target features
- [`calc_road_density()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_road_density.md)
  : Compute Road Network Density per Polygon
- [`erase_water_bodies()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/erase_water_bodies.md)
  : Erase Large Water Bodies from Polygons
- [`get_poly_attr_for_point()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/get_poly_attr_for_point.md)
  : Extract Polygon Attributes for Point Locations
- [`get_utm_crs()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/get_utm_crs.md)
  : Get UTM CRS for a SpatVector (averaging centroids if multiple
  features)
- [`compare_adm_div()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/compare_adm_div.md)
  : Compare hierarchical administrative names between two datasets

## Statistics and dates

- [`cv()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/cv.md) : Compute
  Coefficient of Variation (CV)
- [`skewness()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/skewness.md) :
  Calculate sample skewness
- [`calc_mode()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/calc_mode.md)
  : Compute the statistical mode of a vector
- [`find_lag()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/find_lag.md) :
  Compute the number of complete time intervals between two dates
- [`check_dates_complete()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/check_dates_complete.md)
  : Check Completeness of a Date Sequence
- [`filter_between()`](https://jmr-fao.github.io/c4e/reference/filter_between.md)
  : Filter data frame rows based on a date range
